description: Compare two web pages (or HTML strings) pixel-by-pixel and return a diff image highlighting all visual differences. Supports full-page capture, device emulation, element selectors, and all screenshot-like options. Returns the diff image, changed pixel count, and percentage changed. Costs 1 API request.

blockChats.description: Block live chat widgets on the page

blockRequests.description: URL patterns to block (array of strings)

blockTrackers.description: Block tracking scripts on the page

click.description: CSS selector to click before capturing on both pages

clip.description: Crop region { x, y, width, height } in pixels

cookies.description: Cookies to set — array of "name=value" strings or { name, value, domain? } objects

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before capture on both pages (default: 0)

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page for both sides (default: false)

fullPageMaxHeight.description: Maximum pixel height cap for full-page captures

fullPageScroll.description: Auto-scroll pages before capture to trigger lazy-loaded images

fullPageScrollBy.description: Pixels to scroll per step (default: viewport height)

fullPageScrollDelay.description: Delay between scroll steps in ms (default: 400)

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with the request

hideSelectors.description: Array of CSS selectors to hide before capture

html_a.description: Raw HTML for the first page (required if no url_a)

html_b.description: Raw HTML for the second page (required if no url_b)

injectCss.description: Custom CSS to inject before capturing (max 50KB)

injectJs.description: Custom JavaScript to execute before capturing (max 50KB)

selector.description: CSS selector — capture only this element on both pages

threshold.description: Pixelmatch sensitivity 0–1 (default: 0.1). Lower = more sensitive to subtle differences.

url_a.description: URL of the first page (required if no html_a)

url_b.description: URL of the second page (required if no html_b)

viewportDevice.description: Device preset for viewport emulation (e.g. "iphone_14_pro"). Use list_devices to see all presets.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing

waitUntil.description: When to consider navigation finished (default: networkidle2)

name: visual_diff
